en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a historic European spa or resort town nestled in a valley with forested hills in the background. The foreground is filled with dense late‑19th‑century multi‑story townhouses and grand hotels, laid out along curving streets and a narrow canal or river on the left. Terraced gardens, promenades, and large sanatorium‑like buildings occupy the slopes to the right. On the distant hilltop stands a solitary tower or monument. No printed caption or text is visible on the image.
